location.name: Glasgow Bishopton, SCT, GBR
location.notes: Generated from the EPW LOCATION/DESIGN CONDITIONS header and hourly records. IANA time zone inferred from the UTC offset (EPW stores only the offset). Anemometer (10 m) and station (1.8 m) heights assumed.

summary_data_sets.notes: Annual design conditions parsed from the EPW DESIGN CONDITIONS header line (ASHRAE spreadsheet columns P-CL) and converted to base SI units. Monthly design tables, degree days, precipitation and solar are not carried in the EPW header.

notes: Hourly typical-meteorological-year series. EPW missing-value sentinels (99.9, 999, 9999, ...) are represented as null.

time_series_data_sets.notes: 8760 hourly records converted from the EPW data block. TMYx files draw each month from a different source year; a single regular hourly interval is used for the example.
